title: Oxford Reading Tree: Read With Biff, Chip and Kipper — First Stories — Level 1: Floppy Did This
synopsis: Floppy Did This is a simple, beginning‑reader story. Because it is Level 1, the vocabulary is very basic, and the structure repeats key words. The story revolves around things Floppy (the dog) does, often causing some mischief or unexpected results.
